data.description: The folder that is the default backend and the default write target: layers, specs and runs live here

backends.description: Further backends, read together with the data folder: S3, another server, a device lab

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Names where a result came from

url.description: A folder, s3://bucket/prefix, r2://, gs://, or another Atlas server (https://…)

write.description: Uploads go here instead of the data folder. At most one backend is the write target
The id of the backend uploads go to. Default: the data folder

outlineBranch.description: Which branch's specs the report is laid over. Default main, then master, then the newest

branches.description: Only layers recorded on these branches take part

ignoreModified.description: Leave out layers from modified checkouts and unknown origins

refreshSeconds.description: How often the backends are looked at for layers written by something other than this server

maxObjectMiB.description: The largest object an upload may be

maxJsonMiB.description: The largest JSON body (a manifest, a checks request)

maxStreams.description: Viewers that may be connected for live updates at once

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often a live connection is touched, so proxies keep it open

runTimeoutSeconds.description: Interrupt a live run after this many seconds without a producer heartbeat

runStallSeconds.description: Interrupt after this many seconds without test progress; 0 disables progress expiry
